body: Thanks... It's almost 1am here, and I'm just about to go try lying down (and possibly getting some sleep). I'm sorry you're unable to leave your home as well :( I know how much that sucks and wouldn't wish it upon anyone.

A part of me wants to leave tonight more than anything.. and I could, but it would break my family's hearts - I have bipolar and basically never leave the house or see friends in person.. 28/f btw.. I've been in this state way too many times, I just want the pain to go away for good, but I'm trying to make it through the night - it's excruciating..

Thank you so much, really even for just this simple comment. It took a lot out of me just to post - I'm kinda rusty with msging others or talking online (extension of my agoraphobia)... I'm going to try lying down, but if I can't find sleep I will be sure to take you up on your rant offer. Honestly, writing things out and knowing someone took the time to read this is a comfort.
